from calendar_core import day_summary
from calendar_core.slots import Event, overlaps, free_slots, fmt_duration


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: 09:00-10:00 and 09:30-11:00 in 08:00-12:00 give 2 events busy 2h longest 1h."""
    events = [Event(540, 600), Event(570, 660)]
    # busy: 660-540=120 -> "2h 00m"; free: 540-480=60, 720-660=60 -> longest 60 -> "1h 00m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "2 events | busy 2h 00m | longest free 1h 00m"


def test_issue_singular():
    """N is written as '1 event' (singular) when N is 1."""
    events = [Event(540, 600)]
    # busy: 600-540=60 -> "1h 00m"; free: 540-480=60, 720-600=120 -> longest 120 -> "2h 00m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "1 event | busy 1h 00m | longest free 2h 00m"


def test_issue_zero_events():
    """Empty day has 0 events, no busy time, and whole day free."""
    events = []
    # busy: 0 -> "0h 00m"; free: 720-480=240 -> "4h 00m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "0 events | busy 0h 00m | longest free 4h 00m"


def test_issue_overlapping_counts_once():
    """D1 counts overlapping covered minutes only once."""
    events = [Event(540, 660), Event(570, 600)]
    # busy: 660-540=120 (not 120+30=150) -> "2h 00m"; free: 540-480=60, 720-660=60 -> "1h 00m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "2 events | busy 2h 00m | longest free 1h 00m"


def test_issue_full_day_no_free():
    """D2 is '0h 00m' if there is no free gap inside the day."""
    events = [Event(480, 720)]
    # busy: 720-480=240 -> "4h 00m"; free: none -> 0 -> "0h 00m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "1 event | busy 4h 00m | longest free 0h 00m"


def test_issue_partly_outside_clipped():
    """N counts partly-outside overlap but D1 clips to the day."""
    events = [Event(420, 540)]
    # busy: 540-480=60 -> "1h 00m"; free: 720-540=180 -> "3h 00m"; N: 420<720 and 540>480 -> 1
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "1 event | busy 1h 00m | longest free 3h 00m"


def test_issue_touching_boundary_not_counted():
    """N counts only events overlapping [day_start, day_end), touching does not count."""
    events = [Event(420, 480), Event(720, 780)]
    # busy: 0 -> "0h 00m"; free: 720-480=240 -> "4h 00m"; N: end==480 and start==720 share no minute -> 0
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "0 events | busy 0h 00m | longest free 4h 00m"


def test_issue_back_to_back_no_gap():
    """Back-to-back events leave no free gap between them."""
    events = [Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)]
    # busy: 660-540=120 -> "2h 00m"; free: 540-480=60, 720-660=60 -> longest 60 -> "1h 00m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "2 events | busy 2h 00m | longest free 1h 00m"


def test_issue_padded_durations_longest():
    """D1 and D2 are formatted with fmt_duration and D2 is the longest gap."""
    events = [Event(540, 605)]
    # busy: 605-540=65 -> "1h 05m"; free: 540-480=60, 720-605=115 -> longest 115 -> "1h 55m"
    assert day_summary(events, 480, 720) == "1 event | busy 1h 05m | longest free 1h 55m"


def test_contract_back_to_back_no_overlap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    # 600-540=60 and 660-600=60 share endpoint 600 but no minute
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)) is False


def test_contract_free_slots_clips_outside():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    # clipped cover: max(420,480)=480 to min(500,720)=500, so gap is 720-500=220
    assert free_slots([Event(420, 500)], 480, 720) == [(500, 720)]


def test_contract_fmt_duration_padding():
    """fmt_duration renders minutes as Xh YYm with zero-padded minutes."""
    # 65 = 60+5 -> "1h 05m"
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"
